nodes.description: Mapping (address => Holder) storing per-user unlockTime and balance in pig_BANK.
Reference to the Log contract used to record Put/Collect messages.
Public uint minimum balance threshold (1 ether) required to Collect.
Public payable function that credits msg.value to Acc[msg.sender].balance and sets unlockTime.
Public payable function that performs an external call to msg.sender before updating balance (reentrancy vulnerable).
Anonymous payable fallback function that forwards to Put(0).
Constructor that wires the Log contract reference into LogFile.
Caller-controlled address used as mapping key, call target and log sender.
now (block.timestamp) used for unlockTime comparison and log timestamping.
msg.sender.call.value(_am)() low-level external call executed before balance is decremented.
Parameter of Put controlling the account unlock timestamp.
Parameter of Collect specifying the amount to withdraw.
Local storage reference to Acc[msg.sender] inside Put.
Local storage reference to Acc[msg.sender] inside Collect.
Constructor parameter supplying the Log contract address.
Public array of Message structs storing the full log history in Log.
Temporary Message struct assembled before being pushed to History.
Public function in Log that fills LastMsg and pushes it onto History.
Address parameter of AddMessage stored in LastMsg.Sender.
Value parameter of AddMessage stored in LastMsg.Val.
String data parameter of AddMessage stored in LastMsg.Data.

edges.reason: Put uses msg.sender as the key into the Acc mapping to select the caller's Holder record.
_unlockTime parameter flows into acc.unlockTime assignment in Put.
block.timestamp (now) determines the stored unlockTime, making Put timestamp dependent.
Local acc aliases Acc[msg.sender] and is written to inside Put.
Put writes a message through LogFile.AddMessage.
msg.sender is the destination of the low-level value call in Collect.
_am parameter is used in the balance checks and in the external call value.
Collect requires now > acc.unlockTime, making withdrawal timestamp dependent.
MinSum is read in the Collect balance guard condition.
Local acc aliases Acc[msg.sender] and its balance is decremented in Collect.
Collect transfers control to an external contract via the low-level call.
The external call can re-enter Collect before acc.balance is decremented.
State write acc.balance -= _am happens only after the untrusted external call succeeds.
Collect logs the successful withdrawal through LogFile.AddMessage.
Fallback function forwards all value to Put(0).
Constructor parameter log is assigned to the LogFile state variable.
Constructor initializes LogFile from the supplied Log address.
msg.sender is written into LastMsg.Sender by AddMessage.
AddMessage records block.timestamp in LastMsg.Time.
_adr parameter is stored into LastMsg.Sender.
_val parameter is stored into LastMsg.Val.
_data parameter is stored into LastMsg.Data.
LastMsg struct is populated by AddMessage.
AddMessage pushes LastMsg into the History array.
AddMessage mutates the LastMsg state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _unlockTime only exists to feed the Put function's unlockTime assignment.
Parameter _am only exists to feed the Collect function's balance check and external call value.
Local acc is a temporary alias of Acc[msg.sender] used exclusively inside Put.
Local acc is a temporary alias of Acc[msg.sender] used exclusively inside Collect and updated after the unsafe call.
Parameter log is only used to initialize LogFile in the pig_BANK constructor.
Parameter _adr is only written into LastMsg inside AddMessage.
Parameter _val is only written into LastMsg inside AddMessage.
Parameter _data is only written into LastMsg inside AddMessage.
